findings.highlight: He just hasn't been quite as motivated lately.
findings.evidenceJa: 今まではね、本人にやる気がなかっただけ
findings.governingReading: 今までは本人にやる気がなかっただけ says he had not been motivated before this new training development.
findings.explanation: A lack of motivation until now becomes a recent comparative dip.

findings.highlight: talent isn't everything. Just when I thought he was okay in archery
findings.evidenceJa: 弓道はちょっと、この子大丈夫なのかなーって思うぐらいだった
findings.governingReading: The contrast denies sword talent while archery made Taiga wonder whether the child was all right; the source describes unsettling prowess, not newly reaching ordinary competence.
findings.explanation: His worryingly extraordinary archery becomes being merely okay, with a new talent maxim.

findings.highlight: If she asked me why I admired them, I would have nothing to say in response.
findings.evidenceJa: 問われた時、俺には返す答えがなかった
findings.governingReading: 問われた時 and なかった look back at the second why question and his inability to answer it.
findings.explanation: A question already asked becomes a hypothetical question she might ask.

findings.highlight: something is keeping me from saying it aloud.
findings.evidenceJa: それは決して口にしてはいけない事なのだと、無意識で縛っている自分がいる
findings.governingReading: He identifies a self that unconsciously binds him under the rule that this answer must never be spoken.
findings.explanation: Unconscious self-imposition of an absolute speech taboo becomes an unspecified obstacle.

findings.evidenceJa: 誰も成し得ないのなら
findings.governingReading: 誰も成し得ない states inability to achieve it, preceding his taking up the inherited aspiration.
findings.explanation: Nobody being able to accomplish the ideal becomes nobody going to do it.
